purpose: Convert conversation-level operational requirements into a client-service research pipeline with auditable bibliography acquisition, hypothesis queues, provenance and non-regression gates.
invariants: same DOI may merge identity but provider occurrences are preserved
provider-local IDs are preserved when DOI is absent

conversation_items_projected.implementation: query-set priorities plus next_gates in daily receipt
occurrences.jsonl + content_identities.jsonl; DOI first, provider-local fallback
hypothesis_ledger.jsonl with H1/H0/test/falsifier; thesis promotion remains gated
network acquisition from public research providers; no synthetic provider success
scheduled GitHub Actions artifact, read-only repository permission
claim fence, syntax gate, manifest hashes, source-state recording
query config decoupled from engine so client-specific research questions can be versioned without rewriting acquisition logic
kept orthogonal; bibliography evidence may inform benchmark/support material but does not substitute handset execution receipts

atlas.L: daily runs, provider timestamps, predecessor receipts, evidence age
atlas.O: independent provider agreement/disagreement and later replication/review
atlas.C: query, scope, source availability, authentication state, claim boundary
atlas.P: provider IDs, DOI/arXiv/Zenodo/ORCID identifiers, SHA-256 manifests, append-only receipts
